blogs.title: Potato, Carrot and Beetroot Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए आलू, गाजर और चुकंदर प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
I have already share carrots and potato puree in my blog already. For a variation, I added some beetroots in the puree as well. So it is more healthy and nutritious. Beetroots have not only the amazing color, but it is also rich in antioxidants, folate, manganese, potassium, vitamin -A and many other properties. So it is good for your babies. 

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth. 

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience potatoes won't cause any constipation in babies. But it may cause gas in some babies. Anyhow, I won't feed this puree daily, I give it thrice a week.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5)When choosing potatoes, get firm, white variety. And carrots and beets should be sweet and firm.

6)Potato, carrots, and beets are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

7)After having this puree, your baby's poop will be red in color. don't panic seeing that, it is because of the beets. 

 

How to make Carrot, Beetroot & Potato Puree:

 

Choose a fresh, firm potato, beetroot and carrot. Wash them well. Peel them slightly. Cube them. Put them in water and wash them well till there is no starch.  

Now transfer them in a saucepan, cover them with clean water. 

Place it on the stove and bring it to boil. Cover it and simmer it. Cook for 12 to 15 mins till the veggies are completely cooked. 

Now drain the veggies to a bowl or a mixer. Reserve the cooking liquid. 

You can puree them in a blender or use a hand-blender. Use the reserved liquid to thin the puree if needed. 

Transfer this to a bowl and feed your baby with a spoon.

blogs.title: Pomegranate Juice Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए अनार का जूस रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Summer is here. It is absolutely crucial to feed as much liquid food to your baby either as water or in the form of juices. There are certain fruits which you should avoid for babies and certain fruits can be given for them. This series gives an idea about what fruit juice you can feed your baby and the best way to juice it. I hope it will help you.

 

I am starting with the most health packed fruit which is pomegranate, It cures digestive problems in babies, intestinal worms control fevers and has lots of liver protection problems. You can refer more to their properties here.

 

Things to remember before feeding baby:

 

1) No seeds of this should be given for babies. Only juice must be fed. 

2) Make sure you don't grind the white skin of the pomegranate. Remove all of them and grind only the seeds of pomegranate so the juice will be sweet.

3) If your juice is not that sweet, you can add some sweetener to it.

4) Don't feed this at night, morning and afternoon is a good time to feed juice for baby.

5) This won't cause gas problems or constipation in babies.

 

How to introduce solid food to your baby:

 

How to make Pomegranate Juice:

Take a firm fresh pomegranate. Make sure the pomegranate seeds are not sour, it should be sweet.

Cut them open. Take a wooden spoon or a ladle. Use the back of it bashes the pomegranate to get all the seeds out.

Now take the seeds alone in a blender and puree them.

Place a strainer over a bowl. Pour the puree over it and press with a spoon to get as much juice as possible.

Now pour the juice in a sipper or feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Pear ( Sauce ) Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए नाशपाती (सॉस) प्यूरी पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Pears make great baby food. I give apple puree one day, pear puree the next day and I mix them and make apple pear puree and feed her. I also add a dash of cinnamon to spice it up. Check out my detail post about spicing baby foods. Pear makes great first food for babies since it is less allergenic and it easily digests. Your baby will love it for sure.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion and experience, pears won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge. 

 

How to make Pear Puree:

 

Take a firm fresh and sweet pear. Wash them well.

Peel them, decore them and cube them. 

Place it in a bowl and place that over a saucepan with water, Put it on the stove and bring it to a boil, cover and simmer the pan. Cook on a low heat for 10 to 12 mins.

You can steam them as you wish. 

Now take them in a blender and puree them. 

Pour into a clean bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Sooji ( Rava ) Kheer Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए सूजी (रवा) खीर रेसिपी
blogs.content:
When your baby gets bored to the usual ragi porridge, raw banana porridge, and wheat porridge, then this sooji porridge comes as a lifesaver. It is so easy to prepare and so healthy for babies too. There are certain things you have to read must before making this.

 

Things to remember before making this:

 

1) Roast sooji well in the ghee this makes it easy to digest in babies.

2) You can roast sooji in bulk and store it in an airtight container in the fridge and use it accordingly.

3) If you want a finer and smooth kheer, powder the roasted sooji in a blender, this will make smoother kheer and your baby will find it easy to swallow. I make it that way only. The texture depends upon your baby's interest. 

4) For babies above 1-year-old, you can make this kheer with cow’s milk, for babies below 1-year cow’s milk is not advisable.

5) Don't add formula milk to hot kheer since formula milk should not be cooked, let the kheer comes to a warm temp in which you feed your baby, then add the prepared formula milk.

6) I use panakarkandu or karupatti as a sweetener. Karupatti strengthens your baby bones. Panakarkandu helps to prevent cold for your babies. You can even mix up a small piece of both.

7) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling.

8) Sooji doesn’t cause constipation in babies.

9) Sooji is easy to digest and non-allergenic food.

10)The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

 

How to make Sooji Kheer for Babies & Infants :

 

Ingredients: 

 

Sooji / Semolina / Suji / Rava – 2 tablespoon

Jaggery /Sarkarai / Vellam / Palmsugar – 2 tablespoon

Clean Water – 1 cup

Ghee – 1 tsp

Formula Milk – 1/4 cup (Use cow’s milk for babies above 1 year)

                           (I use lactogen for my baby) 

 

Method:

 

Take a clean saucepan and add in a tsp of ghee. Add in sooji and roast it on a low flame till it turns light golden. Now remove that to a bowl. 

In the same saucepan add in jaggery and some water. Heat it till jaggery melts. Now strain this mix and pour it into a saucepan.

Add in roasted sooji and mix well. Cook till the sooji is well cooked, it will take around 10 mins.

Now remove the saucepan from heat and let it cool a bit. Meanwhile, make formula milk. Pour this milk to the warm sooji kheer and mix well.

Pour into sterilized bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Moong Dal Khichdi Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए मूंग दाल खिचड़ी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
As you all know rice is rich in carbohydrates and it gives the energy which your baby needs and helps in healthy weight gain. Adding dal into rice makes it more wholesome and provides the protein which your baby needs.

 

Things to remember before making this

1) Cook rice and dal properly till it is almost mashed up, which helps in easy digestion in babies.

2) Always wash rice and dal very well to remove all the starch and wacky stuff from it.

3) Add garlic, cumin and asafoetida help in digestion in babies.

4) This khichdi is so filling and nutritious meal for your babies.

5) You can start feeding this for babies above 6 months.

6) Always feed this meal for lunch, not for dinner.

7) The consistency of this is up to you. You can mash them with a potato masher, or put them in a blender and make into a fine puree. I make it into a fine puree.

8) Adding ghee enhances the flavor and makes it more nutritious for your baby and helps in weight gaining in babies.

9) Make sure the ghee which you use is pure ones. I make my own ghee.

10) Rice won't cause constipation, allergies in babies. 

 

How to make Rice & Dal Khichdi:

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 3 tablespoon

Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 3 tablespoon

Garlic – 2 fat cloves

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 tsp

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – a pinch

Turmeric Powder / Manjal Podi – 1/4 tsp 

Salt to taste

Homemade Ghee – 1 tablespoon

Water – 1 1/2 cup

 

 

Method:

 

Take rice and dal in a bowl and wash it well. Now drain it and add it into a pressure cooker.

Add in garlic, cumin seeds, asafoetida, salt, turmeric powder, and asafoetida.

Add in water and cover the cooker. Pressure cook this for 5 whistles and simmer it for 5 mins. Switch off the flame and let the steam escape all by itself.

Open the cooker and mash the rice with a potato masher or if you want it to be smooth, you can take that in a blender and puree them.

Pour this into a bowl. Drizzle in homemade ghee and mix well.

Feed your baby warm.

blogs.title: Homemade Health Mix Powder ( Sathu Maavu Mix ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: घर का बना स्वास्थ्य मिश्रण पाउडर (सत्तू मावू मिक्स) बच्चों के लिए पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This is a super-duper healthy mix for your baby. You could buy a decent health powder mix from shops. But I love to make it myself for my baby because you get to know what goes into them and you can customize it as per your baby needs. 

I added rice and pulses in my health mix. So I feed this porridge for my baby for lunch instead of giving rice khichdi. I made two versions of this powder, one savory and one sweet. 

 

For making porridge out of it:

 

you can mix a couple of tablespoons of this powder with some water and cook it for 10 mins on a very low flame till the rice and dal are cooked. Then you can add some sweetener to sweet one and salt in the savory one. It is that simple.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 1 hour

 

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 1.5 cup ( I used cooking rice, ponni brand)

Barley – 1 cup

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai / Pottu Kadalai – 1 cup

Whole Black Urad Dal – 1 cup

Green Gram Dal – 1 cup

Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1/2 cup

Masoor Dal – 1/2 cup

Broken Wheat / Cracked Wheat / Dalia – 1 cup

Cashew – 1/2 cup

Badam / Almond – 1/2 cup

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1 teaspoon

Ajwain Seeds / Omam – 1/2 teaspoon

Cardamom / Yelakai – 10 pods (If using this, leave ajwain and cumin)

 

 

Method:

 

Take urad dal and green gram in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to a plate.

Take masoor dal and yellow moong dal in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same plate.

Take rice and barley in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same

plate.

Roast roasted gram dal till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast Dalia till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cashews and almonds till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cumin and ajwain till golden and remove to the same plate. If you are making a sweet one, leave ajwain and cumin and add cardamom to it.

I made two versions, so I took half of the mix and added cardamom to one and roasted cumin and ajwain in another. Now grind them in a mixer and sieve it.

Store in an airtight container.

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

     

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use.

 

How to make Steamed Dosa:

Ingredients:

 

Dosa Batter – a small ladle

Ghee – 1 teaspoon

Warm Water, Salt, and Pepper for serving

 

Method:

Heat a Tawa, once it is hot, spread dosa. Cover it with a lid and let it cook on a very low flame for a min.

Now remove it to a plate, spread ghee over it while it is still hot. 

Feed your baby.

blogs.title: Homemade Ghee ( Clarified Butter ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: घर का बना घी (क्लेरिफाइड बटर) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Ghee, Ghee, Ghee. One of my favorite ingredients to have on hand. I love to add it to so many of my curries, especially whenever I make dal I make tempering with ghee, it gives a nice flavor to the dish. I even make these ghee cookies, when I want something sweet. Ghee is such a versatile ingredient and has a long shelf life than butter. 

This ghee is much more aromatic than your store-bought ones and you will be smelling it all the time. I hope you will like it and let me know if you try it.

 

Preparation Time: 0 mins

Cooking Time: 30 to 40 mins

 

Ingredients:

 

Homemade Butter – 500 grams

Drumstick leaves –  2 sprigs

 

Method:

Take butter in a heavy bottom pan and heat it up on medium heat. Now the butter will melt and the milk solids will separate from it and start to foam up.

Keep on heating, now the foam will subside a little and it will bubble up. The water from the butter will start evaporating and reducing.

Now the milk solid will get toasted and it will get settled at the bottom, leaving a clear golden liquid.

Now add in drumstick leaves and let them crisp up.

Once crisp, turn off the heat and let the ghee gets cool.

Once it is cooled, strain it in an airtight container.

Store at room temp.

 

Notes:

1) Always cook butter on a low to medium heat to avoid burning.

2) You can use store-bought yellow butter, I used white butter.

3) You can add some salt or curry leaves when u add drumstick leaves.

4) After draining the ghee, we mix the sediments with some cooked rice and enjoy it. It is so tasty.

5) Use thick bottom pan for cooking ghee.

6) Don't use cold butter directly on hot Kadai, it may burn. Use room temperature butter

blogs.title: Healthy Nuts Powder Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए हेल्दी नट्स पाउडर रेसिपी
blogs.content:
If you want to make this for older babies. just add some Pista, raisins, walnuts, dates to make it more healthy.

 

This is great as a daily health booster for your babies. You can add a spoonful of this in your baby's porridge when you cook it and feed her. This is like magic and maha loves it so much. I add this to my ragi porridge, banana porridge and a new recipe which I will share soon. You can in fact add this whatever you make. Just for an idea, check out my baby recipes. 

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Nuts Powder at Home:

 

Ingredients:

Roasted Gram Dal / Pottu Kadalai / Pori kadalai – 1 cup

Cashews – 1/2 cup

Badam / Almonds – 1/2 cup

Dry Ginger – 2-inch piece or 2 tsp of the powdered one

blogs.title: Muskmelon ( Cantaloupe ) Puree Recipe For Babies
blogs.title_hi: बेबीज़ के लिए मस्कमेलन (कैंटालूप) प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Melons are such a wonder food for your babies during hot summer days. Since they are filled with lots of water content, they make a yummy dish for your baby, plus you don't have to cook them. These melons are rich in vitamin A, vitamin C, and calcium. It is rich in beta carotene which is good for your baby's vision. Choose melon which smells sweet and feed melons which are sweet, because some tart melons can cause rashes in babies. 

 

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth. 

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience melons won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don't prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) When choosing melons, get sweet-smelling melons, the melons should be sweet, don't feed your baby tart melons.

6) Melons are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

   

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls:

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use.

 

How to Make Melon Puree:

Take some ripe sweet melon, peel them and cube them. Add them to a blender and make into a fine puree. Pour into a feeding bowl and feed your baby.

4) This won't cause gas problems or constipation in babies.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Pomegranate Juice:

 

Take a firm sweet watermelon. Make sure the watermelon is sweet.

Cut them open. Now take the flesh alone in a blender and puree them.

Place a strainer over a bowl. Pour the puree over it and press with a spoon to get as much juice as possible.

Now pour the juice in a sipper or feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Sweet Potato ( Mashed ) Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए शकरकंद (मसला हुआ) प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Sweet Potatoes are such wholesome food to give for babies. It has so many health benefits, read all of them here. I boil sweet potatoes and feed, but to bring out the maximum sweetness from them, it is best to oven roast them, just slice them in half, wrap them in foil and roast it for 40 to 45 mins. 

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience, sweet potatoes won't cause any constipation in babies. But it may cause gas in some babies. Anyhow, I won't feed this puree daily, I give it twice a week.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) When choosing sweet potatoes, get firm, red variety and sweet ones.

6) Sweet Potato is less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

7) You can introduce this to your baby after 8 months.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Sweet Potato Puree: 

 

Choose a fresh, firm sweet potato. Wash them well. Peel them slightly. Cube them. Put them in water and wash them well till there is no starch.  

Now transfer them in a saucepan, cover them with clean water.  

Place it on the stove and bring it to boil. Cover it and simmer it. Cook for 12 to 15 mins till the potato is completely cooked.  

Now you can either drain it or if there is not much liquid left in the saucepan, you can puree it using a hand blender right from the saucepan too.

Transfer this to a bowl and feed your baby with a spoon.
